_lisezMoi: Traduction anglaise des notes des données (S32) : par fichier, le texte français tel qu'il est dans data/<fichier>, puis sa traduction. Les noms du jeu restent en anglais dans les deux langues. Une note qui change ici ou là perd sa traduction : le site la montre en français, marquée (FR), et le test src/i18n/data-notes.test.ts la compte. Section « site » : les notes que le site lui-même écrit avec une correction ou un relevé (src/ui), gardées en français dans les fichiers exportés et traduites à l'affichage.

items.json.Le Boiler a deux entrées d'eau (ports re: The Boiler has two water inputs (ports recorded in game): “Water in (to convert to steam)” and “Hot water in”, plus “Used water out”. Miraheze counts both inputs (6), Fandom only the water converted (3): both are right (user, 2026-10-13). The hot water comes from a water heater (“Coolant out (put into boiler coolant in)”): without a water heater, no steam.

modular.json.Cerveau et alimentation électrique de la: Brain and power supply of the farm: it sets the farm's area.
modular.json.Un seul par ferme ; plusieurs à portée d: Only one per farm; several within reach of the same block break the farm.
modular.json.Portée du contrôleur, depuis son bord :: Controller range, from its edge: 58 cells (60 from its center, the block being 4 × 4).
modular.json.Placement libre ; conseillé au centre de: Placed freely; best in the middle of the trees.
modular.json.Un réservoir alimente au plus 3 arroseur: A tank feeds at most 3 sprinklers, whatever its volume.
modular.json.Doit être à portée du contrôleur (le mêm: Must be within reach of the controller (the same one as the sprinklers').
modular.json.Chaque réservoir doit être alimenté en e: Each tank must be fed with water, including those added to go beyond 3 sprinklers (in game). Miraheze said the opposite.
modular.json.Portée infinie vers les arroseurs : il s: Unlimited range to the sprinklers: the tank only needs to be within the controller's reach.
modular.json.Arrose les arbres à sa portée ; sans arr: Waters the trees within its reach; without water, a tree doesn't grow.
modular.json.Portée de l'arroseur, depuis son bord :: Sprinkler range, from its edge: 10 cells (12 from its center, the block being 4 × 4).
modular.json.Ne marche que si un réservoir est à port: Only works if a tank is within the controller's reach.
modular.json.Pousse puis donne des Oak Logs quand un: Grows, then gives Oak Logs when a harvester cuts it.
modular.json.Bras robotisé : coupe les arbres mûrs à: Robotic arm: cuts the grown trees within its reach and drops the Oak Logs into an output.
modular.json.Portée du récolteur vers les arbres, dep: Harvester range to the trees, from its edge: 23 cells (27 from its center, the block being 8 × 8).
modular.json.Avec plusieurs sorties à sa portée, le r: With several outputs within its reach, the harvester picks one, with no rule you can reproduce, and keeps it.
modular.json.Reçoit les Oak Logs et les sort par tuya: Receives the Oak Logs and sends them out by pipe.
Brain of the engine; holds the settings.
modular.json.Un seul par moteur ; plusieurs cassent l: Only one per engine; several break the engine.
modular.json.Au bout du moteur : les vilebrequins se: At the end of the engine: the crankshafts are placed in front of it; it isn't placed on a side. Its sides take the same blocks as a crankshaft's (recorded on 2026-10-18), or a sideways crankshaft.
modular.json.Devant obligatoire : la ligne de vilebre: Front required: the line of crankshafts starts from it. Its sides are optional (a Crankshaft Sideways can start a 2nd line there).
modular.json.Relie les blocs ; prolonge le moteur en: Links the blocks; extends the engine in a straight line.
modular.json.Un côté plat et trois côtés à tiges. Le: One flat side and three sides with rods. The flat side faces the controller (or the previous crankshaft); the front rod takes the next crankshaft or the generator; the two side rods take the side blocks.
modular.json.Derrière et devant obligatoires (chaîne: Back and front required (chain controller → crankshafts → generator); sides optional. The first crankshaft of a 2nd line, started from a Crankshaft Sideways, has nothing behind it: to be confirmed.
modular.json.Élargit le moteur : démarre une deuxième: Widens the engine: starts a second line of crankshafts parallel to the first.
modular.json.Deux côtés à tiges : l'un touche le côté: Two sides with rods: one touches the side of a crankshaft, a controller or another sideways crankshaft; the other takes the side of the crankshaft of the new line. It only connects sideways; nothing can be placed on its other faces.
modular.json.Les deux côtés obligatoires : l'un touch: Both sides required: one touches the first line, the other takes the new one.
modular.json.Seul bloc qui brûle le carburant ; donne: The only block that burns fuel; gives the torque.
modular.json.Sur un côté de vilebrequin ou du contrôl: On a side of a crankshaft or of the controller.
modular.json.Posé contre le côté d'un vilebrequin : o: Placed against the side of a crankshaft: required.
modular.json.Posée contre le côté d'un vilebrequin :: Placed against the side of a crankshaft: required.
modular.json.Au moins une ; les gros moteurs (plus de: At least one; big engines (over 400 MT) may need several. Fandom: one air intake is enough for 6 cylinders.
Lets the gases out; gives off the pollution.
modular.json.Au moins un ; « rarement plus d'un » sel: At least one; “rarely more than one” according to the overview page, but big engines (over 400 MT) may need several.
modular.json.Au moins une ; les gros moteurs en deman: At least one; big engines need several (threshold not given).
modular.json.Peut aller n'importe où contre un côté d: Can go anywhere against a side of the set (crankshaft or controller).
modular.json.Au bout d'une chaîne de vilebrequins (ou: At the end of a chain of crankshafts (or of a flywheel, which is placed like a crankshaft).
modular.json.Derrière obligatoire : au bout d'une cha: Back required: at the end of a chain of crankshafts.
modular.json.Les moteurs à fort couple peuvent demand: High-torque engines may need several generators. Where does the second one go, since it sits at the end of the chain?
modular.json.Se place comme un vilebrequin, dans la l: Placed like a crankshaft, in the line: behind it, the controller, a crankshaft or another flywheel; in front, a crankshaft, the generator or another flywheel. You can put several, the order doesn't matter (wiki). Do its sides take blocks? To be recorded.
modular.json.Aucune face obligatoire : le volant se p: No required face: the flywheel is placed like a crankshaft, without being required.
modular.json.Cache les tiges libres des vilebrequins: Hides the free rods of the crankshafts; optional.
modular.json.Sur un côté resté libre (vilebrequin ou: On a side left free (crankshaft or controller).
modular.json.Posée contre le côté d'un vilebrequin re: Placed against the side of a crankshaft left free: required.
modular.json.Début de la turbine ; reçoit la vapeur h: Start of the turbine; takes the high-pressure steam.
modular.json.Début de chaîne : HPT devant (ou directe: Start of the chain: HPT in front (or the IPT directly); its two sides take the steam inputs (steamPorts).
Front required: start of the chain.
modular.json.Fait baisser la pression avant les LPT ;: Lowers the pressure before the LPTs; less efficient than the LPTs; optional.
0 or more; the only optional block.
modular.json.Après l'entrée (ou une autre HPT), avant: After the inlet (or another HPT), before the IPT.
modular.json.Derrière et devant obligatoires (ordre d: Back and front required (order of the chain), when placed.
modular.json.Change la vapeur haute pression en basse: Turns high-pressure steam into low-pressure steam; little torque.
modular.json.Entre les HPT (ou l'entrée) et les LPT ;: Between the HPTs (or the inlet) and the LPTs; its placement arrow must point away from the inlet.
modular.json.Derrière et devant obligatoires (ordre d: Back and front required (order of the chain).
The block that gives the most torque.
modular.json.1 ou plus ; chaque LPT en plus apporte m: 1 or more; each extra LPT adds less, and too many LPTs lower the torque.
modular.json.Après l'IPT ou une autre LPT ; la derniè: After the IPT or another LPT; the last one touches the generator.
modular.json.Produit l'électricité et commande la tur: Produces the electricity and controls the turbine (data node).
modular.json.Juste après les LPT, juste avant la sort: Right after the LPTs, right before the outlet.
modular.json.Derrière et devant obligatoires : entre: Back and front required: between the LPTs and the outlet.
modular.json.Fin de la turbine ; sort la vapeur basse: End of the turbine; lets out the low-pressure steam.
modular.json.Derrière obligatoire : juste après le gé: Back required: right after the generator.
